dataSources: Qlik logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), QRS API (`qlik:qrs`). Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll into the index named in the SPL.
app: Qlik Sense logs via UF; QRS API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC. — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy status="200"
| eval dur_s=round(response_time_ms/1000,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by app_name
| where p95_s>8
| sort - p95_s

detailedImplementation:
Step 1 — Configure data collection

Install and configure the add-on referenced in the app field (Qlik Sense logs via UF; QRS API and Qlik Cloud REST API via HEC. — Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617)). Enable the modular input or HEC token that writes sourcetype=qlik:proxy into bi. Default poll interval 300–900 seconds unless the vendor API rate-limits lower. Grant the ingestion role `list_inputs` and `search` on the target index.

Step 2 — Create the search and alert

Schedule the SPL with earliest=-24h@h and throttle per entity to avoid duplicate pages. Document tunable macros in the comment header. Understanding this SPL: filters in the first pipeline reduce license cost; stats/timechart aggregates define the alert grain; joins/lookups enrich owner or asset metadata for routing.

Step 3 — Validate

Compare `| tstats count where index=... sourcetype=...` against the vendor admin UI inventory count (+/-5%). Spot-check two known entities for field presence (`app_name, p95_s`). Run `timechart count span=1h` over 7 days to find ingestion gaps longer than two poll intervals.

Step 4 — Operationalize

Add a dashboard row with single-value KPI tiles, a 24-hour timechart, and a drilldown table mirroring the SPL output columns. Route critical severity to the platform on-call channel; route warning to the service owner from the lookup.

Step 5 — Troubleshooting

No events: verify forwarder connectivity, HEC token ACLs, and that the modular input appears in `index=_internal source=*splunkd*`. NULL fields: check props/transforms order and TA version. Fewer results than expected: confirm index allow-lists on the search head role and that `_time` uses the correct timezone. API errors: inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Qlik Sense so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
